summary: Phase 3 Green implements the spec faithfully. All 8 reported test failures and all 3 build issues are pre-existing or external, with commit-level evidence. The security review of the OIDC handoff, origin validation, cookie handling, role denial, demo seed, and promote gates found no defects. The legacy-school regression claim of 42 passed was reproduced exactly.

nonblocking_findings.summary: Sales failures at scripts/sales-admin-ui.test.ts:31,48 are pre-existing stale source-grep checks, not introduced by this phase.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: The test reads app/[locale]/admin/{page,[repId]/page,create-rep/page}.tsx. git log eb110834b..045a11940 shows zero commits touching the test or those admin pages. The test last changed in 2ec48b0f2 and the admin sources in 2350ef665/df7a9c3cf, both ancestors of baseline eb110834b. The assertions expect useTranslations("admin") in pages that now delegate to content components. Identical inputs at baseline produce the identical failure.

nonblocking_findings.summary: All 6 Marketing failures are pre-existing and outside the track footprint.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: project-update.test.ts:85 and workflow-correctness.test.ts:244 fail on createdBy/updatedBy audit fields added by b95bbd6a6 (wave5_public_surface_completion_20260628), an ancestor of baseline; the tests were never updated. phase-8-projects-live.test.ts:143,212, project-update-live.test.ts:81, and topic-save-concurrency-live.test.ts:71 fail with PGlite 500s in the same project/topic persistence area. git log eb110834b..045a11940 shows zero commits touching any of the 5 failing test files, app/api/video/projects/route.ts, or app/api/video/*-topics/route.ts. The track diff touches no file these tests import.

nonblocking_findings.summary: codecamp-knowledge apk-blueprint.ts:147 break is the documented external APK-lane artifact.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: Reproduced: tsc --noEmit on @reading-advantage/codecamp-knowledge fails with src/apk-blueprint.ts(147,65) TS2322 Type '"version"' is not assignable to type 'keyof RuntimeCartridgeManifest'. The 'version' field was deleted by APK commit ab3812707 (apk_common_look_enforcement_20260822), an ancestor of baseline. git diff eb110834b..045a11940 --stat -- packages/codecamp-knowledge is empty.

nonblocking_findings.summary: Sales build failure on missing sales-knowledge media file pre-dates the track.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: Reproduced: pnpm --filter sales-advantage run build exits 1 with ENOENT on /ROOT/packages/sales-knowledge/dist/static/media/release-candidate.2n2zxfu1f-c-b.json while collecting /[locale]/admin/[repId]. packages/sales-knowledge last changed in b86b137ff (ancestor of baseline); its build script (tsc + copy-data.mjs) never emits dist/static/media. The track changed no file in the sales-knowledge or admin-page dependency chain.

nonblocking_findings.summary: Accounts build failure on the backend route-adapter import pre-dates the track.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: Reproduced: pnpm --filter accounts run build exits 1, module-not-found at apps/accounts/lib/server/company-identity-route-bindings.ts:3 importing packages/backend/src/modules/company-identity/internal-route-adapter.js. The bindings file last changed in 9355abf62 (ancestor of baseline). The track touched neither apps/accounts/lib nor packages/backend.

nonblocking_findings.summary: Session route 403 also covers anonymous callers, not only no-role sessions.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: authenticateSalesRequest returns null for a missing cookie and for a failed introspection alike; app/api/auth/session/route.ts returns 403 {session:null,denied:true} for both. Spec FR-7 replaces the silent 200-null response wholesale, the legacy rollback verifier passes a valid token and still receives 200, and no in-app code calls the session route anonymously. Behavior matches the written contract.

nonblocking_findings.summary: Promotion gates are process gates an operator can satisfy by writing a note file.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: Both promote scripts require ACCEPTANCE_NOTE to be non-empty and to contain an anchored '^status: pass$' line before update-traffic runs. This matches the plan requirement that promotion runs only after a recorded passing acceptance note; it is not a cryptographic control and cannot stop the operator who runs the script. Design matches spec.

nonblocking_findings.summary: Demo credentials land in .env.local rather than the spec's literal .env; the file is gitignored and mode 0600.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: demo-accounts.ts writes apps/accounts/.env.local; git check-ignore confirms .gitignore:18 covers .env.local. writeDemoEnvironment and writeRotatedPassword apply mode 0o600. .env.example lists variable names without values. No password reaches stdout, stderr, git, or test output.

evidence: Sales full suite rerun: 253 passed, 2 failed (scripts/sales-admin-ui.test.ts:31,48 only), 9 skipped; exit 1. Matches the implementer record exactly.

Marketing full suite rerun: 509 passed, 6 failed (phase-8-projects-live.test.ts:143,212; project-update-live.test.ts:81; topic-save-concurrency-live.test.ts:71; project-update.test.ts:85; workflow-correctness.test.ts:244); exit 1. Matches the implementer record exactly.
Accounts full suite rerun: 58 passed, 1 skipped; exit 0.

Legacy regression rerun with SALES_AUTH_MODE=legacy-school over the 12 auth, proxy, login-form, and landing suites: 42 passed, exit 0. The implementer claim is reproduced exactly. The full sales suite under legacy mode shows the same 2 pre-existing admin failures and no new failure.

Start-route handoff mirrors Codecamp: getPublicOrigin validates the forwarded origin against the approved list (production origin, configured origins, *_PREVIEW_ORIGINS); a mismatch with the configured callback origin redirects to the same path on the callback origin with returnTo preserved; the handoff target is never attacker-controlled, so no open redirect exists. Sales lib/public-url.ts is functionally identical to the Codecamp helper (diff shows formatting only).

Preview-origin parsing is https-only and exact-match: configuredPreviewOrigins rejects non-https, credentials, paths, query, hash, and empty entries with PUBLIC_ORIGIN_INVALID; getPublicOrigin rejects unapproved origins and non-http(s) forwarded protocols with PUBLIC_ORIGIN_INVALID.

Cookie handling: all callback failure paths, including the Marketing early return, expire the transaction cookie with httpOnly, host-only (no domain), path=/, sameSite=lax, expires epoch, maxAge 0, and secure derived from the validated origin protocol. The session cookie is set only on success with the same attributes.

Sales callback role denial: salesSessionRole throws when no SALES_ADMIN/SALES_REP role exists; the route then attempts revocation through the OIDC client logout, logs structured revocation failures, expires both cookies, redirects to /?error=forbidden, and never sets a session cookie on denial.
Session route contract: 403 with JSON {"session": null, "denied": true} and Cache-Control no-store, matching FR-7.

demo-accounts.ts: passwords derive from randomBytes(24) base64url; no owner-supplied password path exists; only usernames print to stdout/stderr; roles are SALES_REP and marketing MEMBER (verified against app/lib/marketing-permissions.ts) with a 90-day expires_at; no administrator identity is created; upsert is keyed on normalized_username; disable and rotate commands change only the intended rows; NODE_ENV=test guards prevent any live database execution in tests.

Both promote scripts pass the acceptance-note gate with an anchored '^status: pass$' grep before any gcloud update-traffic call; Marketing keeps domain-mapping, smoke, and ledger evidence inside the promote script.
Secrets scan of the full diff (passwords, keys, tokens, bearer strings, private keys, argon2 hashes) found no credential material.

Contract fidelity spot-checks: proxy.ts contains zero redirectTo references; all 13 Marketing login-redirect call sites across campaigns list, campaign detail, campaign video, and settings use the shared redirectToLogin helper; the Sales legacy-school gate is present in the start route and the proxy; errorSso/errorForbidden keys exist in both messages/en.json and messages/th.json; login.errorSso exists in Marketing i18n; packages/auth/src/company-identity/client.ts is unchanged.

Working tree carried 304 unrelated uncommitted changes from the advantage-games lane during test runs; none intersect the reviewed apps' code under test, so results reflect commits 25d719b09 and 045a11940.
